user_saw: After a provider reported context overflow, a conversation could compact without saving recent decisions to durable memory.
summary: The fix runs the reply-owned memory flush before provider-overflow compaction when the turn has not already attempted one.
reasoning: The oldest readable snapshot already had separate reply-side memory flushing and provider-overflow compaction, with no reply-owned flush in the overflow branch. The July 6 change moved the flush before preflight compaction and did not change provider-overflow recovery. The offline history stops at the July 1 graft, so I could not verify which commit introduced the gap or whether overflow recovery ever ran the flush.
